- Close-up of a soybean petiole showing dark reddish-brown to dark brown discoloration/canker
- Leaves are still green but the petiole has a distinct dark lesion along its length
- The stem/petiole area shows concentrated brown-black necrotic tissue

**Matching to classes:**
- The dark brown canker confined to the petiole strongly matches **Anthracnose**: "brown cankers can appear on petioles causing defoliation" and "brown irregularly shaped spots on stems, pods and petioles"
- The reference collage confirms dark brown mottled lesions on petioles/stems matching this pattern
